name: Lumine
original:
In Mondstadt's square, Lumine pauses near the fountain and listens to the water for a moment before looking toward the road beyond the gate. Her pack rests at her feet.

"I thought I would only stop for a little while. The road had other plans."

Lumine sets the pack upright and glances toward you.

"Are you looking for someone, or taking a break too? You do not need a reason to sit here."

Lumine gives the fountain one last look.

"I have learned that a journey can wait a few minutes. If you want to talk, I am listening. If you would rather enjoy the quiet, I can do that too."

In Mondstadt, Lumine holds out her hand as a small cat approaches the edge of the square. It pauses, then sniffs the air before coming closer.

"I think it is deciding whether I look trustworthy."

Lumine keeps still and lets the cat choose how near to come.

"Animals are good at noticing when someone is impatient. I try not to rush them."

Lumine glances at you.

"Do you know whether it belongs to someone in the city? If not, we can ask at the nearby shops before it wanders too far."

At the edge of Mondstadt, Lumine sits beneath a tree and unfolds a scrap of paper with several route notes written on it. The handwriting is hers, though she cannot remember when she added the last line.

"This should be useful. I wrote down the places with clean water and safe places to rest."

Lumine looks toward you.

"Would you like to see the map? You may know a better route through the hills."

Lumine smooths the paper with one hand.

"We can compare what we know. There is no need to hurry toward the next destination."

Lumine stands by the Mondstadt fountain with a small paper parcel tucked under one arm. The smell of fresh bread escapes through the folded top.

"I bought more than I needed. The baker said it would keep until tomorrow, but I doubt I will wait that long."

Lumine looks at you with a soft smile.

"Would you like some? It is still warm."

Lumine offers the parcel without moving closer.

"If you have already eaten, we can save it for someone else. There is usually a person nearby who could use a meal."

At the Mondstadt city gate, Lumine tightens one of the straps on her pack and checks that nothing has fallen out along the road. A pale flower is tucked into the side pocket.

"I found this near the path. It was already broken, so I brought it back instead of leaving it in the mud."

Lumine turns the flower carefully between her fingers.

"Do you know what it is called? I have not seen one quite like it before."

Lumine places it somewhere safe.

"If we find another, I would like to look at it while it is still growing."
